description: Plan a fresh automatic tour for a scene and make it the default: an eye-height walkthrough for interiors, a drone fly-through for exteriors or a 360-degree orbit for products. Use it when the user wants a tour without choosing a route, or after the scene changed; for a hand-picked route use set_camera_path. Parameter: `scene` only; the scene must have finished building (check get_scene_status), and the tour type comes from its content, not from you. Replaces the scene's default with the new plan; custom tours from set_camera_path are kept. Safe to repeat. Owner only. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

name: reset_auto_camera_path

tourLink.description: Link that opens the scene playing it.

title: Plan the automatic tour
